verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local inference engine, and a hosted cloud tier is a plausible feature for that kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows on-device execution: SSD expert offload, local `edge0 serve` on 127.0.0.1, and model downloads via fetch_models.py. In the evidence, "tier" means a model size class (e.g. edge0-35b), not a hosted service. SSD streaming is an adjacent local-memory technique, not cloud offload, so there is no evidence of running models remotely without downloading them.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can offload very large models to a hosted cloud tier without downloading them when my local hardware is insufficient
